Subject: Follow-up + clarification on procurement & payment path (Cerebra pilot)

Hi Amy —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can align internal teams and keep the pilot timeline on track. Notes below are high level; feel free to correct/expand.

Recap of the ask: pilot to validate embedding-based semantic search for clinical notes (3 month pilot, ~500k tokens/month). You mentioned ROI will be measured by search precision and time-to-insight for clinicians.

To keep the procurement path unblocked we need:
- Who is the economic buyer for this? (you mentioned Sara in finance — can you confirm)
- Procurement intake owner + email (for vendor onboarding, required forms, Coupa/Ariba/SaaS portal)
- Legal counterparty for MSA redlines and NDA (who will own that review)
- Any required security evidence beyond SOC 2 (e.g., penetration test report, jurisdictional data controls)
- Typical PO timeline once SOW is agreed (net terms, approval cadence)

Immediate asks:
1) Can you share the procurement contact and the PO/invoice template Cerebra expects?
2) Confirm whether a basic SOW + vendor questionnaire (we’ll supply SOC 2 report + short security pack) is sufficient to begin vendor intake.
3) Target start date for pilot — we suggested week of July 12; does procurement/finance allow a PO by then if we get SOW in next week?

I’ve CC’d Aditya to own the security evidence pack and Laura to coordinate invoice/finance details on our side. If it helps, we can prepare a short vendor packet (SOW, standard MSA, SOC 2 summary, sample invoice) to accelerate review.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks —

Stakeholders (confirming):

- Security: I’ll loop in our security lead if we need any non-standard controls; SOC 2 Type II is the baseline we expect for vendor onboarding.

Procurement path & timeline:
- Vendor intake + basic vendor questionnaire + SOC 2 review: typically 7–14 business days.
- MSA review/limited redlines: 3–5 business days once Priya starts review.
- PO issuance: usually within 10–30 days after SOW signature depending on budget cycle; for pilots finance has sometimes done net-30 POs with a contract addendum.

Attached is a doc that summarizes our procurement workflow (Cerebra_PO_Workflow_v1.pdf) and an invoice template we prefer.

We can accept a SOW + vendor packet to start the intake. Please send the SOC 2 summary and a short SOW. Targeting week of July 12 for pilot start should be fine if we get SOW this week and procurement starts intake next week.

A few notes on decision criteria Sara cares about: measurable clinician time-savings, data residency controls, and a clear rollback/exit plan for the pilot.

Attachments:
- Cerebra_PO_Workflow_v1.pdf (procurement workflow)
- Cerebra_invoice_template.xlsx (invoice template)
